title: Block code recovers term positions
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ Boolean coordinates with width at most $w$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Regard the block code formed from a set $S$ of literal positions as a set of positions among the first $w$ coordinates. The literal positions corresponding to those code positions are exactly $S$.
hypotheses_covered: The term width is at most $w$
A finite set $S$ of literal positions
